what: Sun Communities owns manufactured housing communities, recreational vehicle resorts and marinas, and rents out the sites. Residents typically own the home or the boat; Sun owns the ground under it.
customers: Retirees and families living in manufactured home communities, RV travellers, and boat owners renting slips.
money: annual and transient RV site rents
wet slips and dry storage for boats
moat: Almost no new manufactured housing communities or marinas get approved, so the existing sites are close to irreplaceable and rents rise with almost no capital spending.
risks: A reported net loss of $773M, driven by write-downs and the sale of the UK business
Transient RV stays are discretionary travel and fall in a weak economy
Revenue has been flat around $2.3B for three years
opportunities: $857M of free cash flow and a 61.3% operating margin on the rental business
Analysts see about 18% upside, with 19 covering the stock
Selling the UK operations left a simpler, lower-debt company at $1.8B of debt against $570M of cash
watch: Same-property rent growth in manufactured housing and occupancy in the RV portfolio.
